import os
import mir_eval

# Navigate from the known beat_reference_file to the pattern reference file
data_dir = os.path.dirname(os.path.dirname(beat_reference_file))
pattern_file = os.path.join(data_dir, 'pattern', 'reference.txt')

# Load the MIREX 2013 formatted pattern file
patterns = mir_eval.io.load_patterns(pattern_file)

# Verify the deeply nested list structure: list[list[list[tuple[float, float]]]]
assert isinstance(patterns, list), "Output must be a list of patterns"
assert len(patterns) > 0, "Should load at least one pattern"

first_pattern = patterns[0]
assert isinstance(first_pattern, list), "Each pattern must be a list of occurrences"
assert len(first_pattern) > 0, "Pattern should have at least one occurrence"

first_occurrence = first_pattern[0]
assert isinstance(first_occurrence, list), "Each occurrence must be a list of events"
assert len(first_occurrence) > 0, "Occurrence should have at least one event"

first_event = first_occurrence[0]
